text:
Emma: Hey design — for next week's webinar + launch post we need a small asset pack: 1) benchmark hero diagram (single-slide, editable) 2) three social image sizes (1:1, 4:5, 16:9) 3) one-page 'how it works' flow with callouts for caching/batching 4) animated storyboard for a 30s explainer. Need brand-checked and localized frames for EU/US. Figmas: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/benchmark-pack

Josh: Got it. Can you confirm final copy for hero? Also do we have a preferred color palette for the hero sparkline? Motion frames in 1080p vs 4K?

Emma: Final hero copy: "Predictable inference. Lower cost. Faster time-to-value." Use the 'Data Spark' palette — hexes below. Motion: 1080p is fine for social + webinar; deliver 4K only if we repurpose for keynote.

Nina: Added localization notes for FR/DE/ES in the figma file. Also: include GDPR-friendly CTA variants and translated CTAs (short + long).

Sam: For the one-pager: can we base the simplified runtime diagram on eng-runtime/kvcache-v2? Link: https://internal.redwood/eng-runtime/kvcache-v2 (will ask eng for a stripped SVG). Need minimal labels: batching, routing, cache, fallback.

Josh: Quick QA items —
1) export sizes I'll produce: 1:1 1080x1080, 4:5 1200x1500, 16:9 1920x1080. OK?
2) Motion spec: 30s storyboard -> 6 frames (each ~5s), 30fps, H.264 MP4 + looping GIF for social.
3) Color hexs we should use: #0057FF, #00C2A8, #0F1724 (dark), #FFFFFF (text). Mini CSS gradient for reference:
```
background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0057FF 0%, #00C2A8 100%);
```

Marco: FYI DesignBot will run an automated brand-compliance check after upload. It flags contrast & font-size issues sometimes.

DesignBot: :robot_face: Draft upload received. Running brand check...
DesignBot: :white_check_mark: Fonts OK. :warning: Contrast ratio for hero CTA is 3.9:1 (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text). Suggest CTA bg #003F9E or increase font weight.

Emma: Thanks — @Josh please bump CTA bg to #003F9E and re-export. Also prepare two CTA variants: one with consent modal flow (GDPR) and one direct link for non-EU. Deadline for first drafts: Tue 10am PT.

Josh: Copy that. I'll update CTA color, re-export the three sizes + motion frames, and upload to Figma under marketing/benchmark-launch/Sprint7. Will post the link when ready.

Sam: I'll draft social copy variants (short, medium, long) and a suggested inbound lead routing map for the launch post (webinar registrants -> MQL tag -> SDR cadence). Will add to the same figma page as notes.

Nina: I can review GDPR CTA language and localization strings once Josh uploads. Also pinging legal for quick sign-off on consent microcopy.

Emma: Awesome. If anything blocks (legal/design resources), flag here or DM me. :raised_hands:

Josh: One more — would you like native captions for the 30s motion piece? I can export SRT alongside MP4.

Emma: Yes please include SRT and an open captions burn-in for social GIF variant.

Marco: Noted. After final upload I'll trigger DesignBot compliance one more time and share the report in this thread.

Emma: Thank you team — excited to get this out. :rocket:
